text: ハーバーシティは45分にエリアス・オカフォールがゴールを決めました！彼のシュートは約12メートルの距離から放たれ、成功率が約15％のチャンスをものにしました。マレク・バロスのスルーパスから生まれたこの得点は、チーム全体で約57秒間、17回もパスをつなぐという辛抱強い攻めの結果でした。これでハーバーシティは0-0から1-0とリードしました！[#905] [#904] [#892]

trace.output: Brief: GOAL - Elias Okafor (Harbour City) for fan audience in ja

- Elias Okafor scored a goal for Harbour City at 45 minutes with an xG of 0.148 from 11.7 meters using his foot [#905]  
- The goal was assisted by Marek Barros with a through pass [#904]  
- The goal completed a patient 17-pass build-up over 56.9 seconds starting from open play [#883-#905]  
- Harbour City were trailing before the goal and leveled the score to 1-0 after it [score_before: 0-0, score_after: 1-0]  
- In the last 10 minutes, Harbour City had 57.0% possession, 89.9% pass accuracy, and created 1 big chance resulting in the goal

- Harbour City executed a patient, short-passing build-up typical of their 4-2-3-1 formation under coach Tomasz Rhee, completing 17 passes over nearly a minute from deep in their own half (start_x_own 20.5) to carefully progress the ball into attacking areas [#moment, #build_up].
- The ball movement involved key players rotating possession—Ezra Lindqvist and Leon Valdez exchanging multiple passes—to maintain control and create passing angles, reflecting their style of methodical buildup before entering the final third [#event_trail 883-890].
- Creative midfielders Malik Castillo and Elias Okafor carried the ball progressively into the final third, repeatedly receiving and advancing the ball, showcasing patient ball retention and targeted progression to destabilize Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 defensive shape [#event_trail 891-902].
- The decisive assist was a precise through ball by Marek Barros to Okafor, who finished from 11.7 meters with his foot, capitalizing on a big chance generated from sustained possession, illustrating the home side’s emphasis on patient, calculated build-up rather than direct or crossing plays favored by the wide-focused 3-4-3 opposition coached by Mara Lindholm [#moment, #build_up, #event_trail 904-905].
- Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 and wide crossing style was effectively countered by Harbour City’s controlled possession and positioning, limiting Seabrook to only 25% field tilt and fewer box touches, preventing the visitors’ wide attackers from gaining significant footholds defensively [#last_10_minutes].
